meta.name: remotion-render
meta.description: Render videos from React/Remotion component code via inference.sh. Pass TSX code, get MP4. Supports all Remotion APIs: useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig, spring, interpolate, AbsoluteFill, Sequence. Configurable resolution, FPS, duration, codec. Use for: programmatic video generation, animated graphics, motion design, data-driven videos, React animations to video. Triggers: remotion, render video from code, tsx to video, react video, programmatic video, remotion render, code to video, animated video, motion graphics code, react animation video

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 React 组件代码渲染成 MP4 视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要用代码批量生成视频或动画
copy.tagline_en: Render React components into MP4 videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate videos or animations programmatically

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你的 React/Remotion 组件 TSX 代码经 belt CLI 提交给 inference.sh 渲染，产出 MP4 视频文件；分辨率、帧率、时长、编码都可配置。
howto.when: 当你提到 remotion、tsx 转视频、代码渲染成视频等关键词，或要求用代码生成程序化视频与动效时触发。

say.text: 渲染这个弹跳动画组件，用 60fps、1080x1080 出片
say.note: 结束后返回生成的视频文件

say.text: 用 props 传入标题「My Video」，渲染成 3 秒视频

howto.what_en: After install, Claude sends your React/Remotion TSX component code to inference.sh through the belt CLI and returns an MP4 video; resolution, FPS, duration and codec are configurable.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention remotion, tsx to video, code to video and similar keywords, or ask to generate programmatic videos and motion graphics from code.

say_en.text: Render this Remotion component code as a 3-second, 30fps, 1920x1080 video
Render this spring animation component at 60fps on a 1080x1080 canvas
Pass the title "My Video" via props and render a 3-second video
say_en.note: Props are passed into the component
